scope: Recurrence schedule edits against occurrence creation; complements the one-time race cases.
assertions: An edit committed first suppresses the replaced due slot.
An occurrence committed first retains the original title and recurrence revision.
Both orderings retain the accepted future slot at revision 2.
A later scheduler call cannot create another occurrence from replaced timing.
The future slot creates one occurrence with the edited title and revision.
Each retained occurrence has exactly one queued Planner after repeated queue handoff.
